# Kodiak Gas Services Announces Quarterly Dividend


November 04, 2026 6:03 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_d9244ad9d8f8710bb7aa47f513a52ae2/kodiakgas/news/2026-11-04_Kodiak_Gas_Services_Announces_Quarterly_88.pdf)


THE WOODLANDS, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Kodiak Gas Services, Inc. (NYSE: KGS), (“Kodiak”) today announced that its board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.51 per share of common stock for the third quarter of 2026, payable on November 25, 2026, to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 16, 2026.


The $0.51 per share dividend represents a 4.1% increase over both the prior quarter and the year-ago quarter. Since Kodiak initiated its dividend in 2023 at $0.38 per share, its quarterly dividend has increased by approximately 34%, reflecting the Company’s commitment to returning capital to stockholders as part of its shareholder return framework.


**About Kodiak**


Kodiak is a leading contract compression, distributed power, and energy infrastructure services provider in the United States. Headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas, Kodiak partners with customers across the energy and digital infrastructure sectors, including oil and gas producers, midstream operators, and data center developers and operators, to deliver safe, reliable, and innovative infrastructure solutions. Additional information is available at[www.kodiakgas.com](http://www.kodiakgas.com/) .
